text.en_US:
Former Seeker of the Track of Ancients from another universe, now turned Seeker of the Stone of Apex. Trained and reborn in the likeness of a powerful sorceror. Attacks relentlessly using deadly combos in close-quarters and lethal combos from far away. 

Imposes the rules of his universe upon you in combat. Still, his amateurish magic leaves a gap for Sergey to assist you in battle. 

 At the start of combat, the following rules are applied: 
-40% movement speed to player
10x player damage dealt
+50% player dash speed

 Innately resists 20% of ranged damage
